_doc: Travel & Map works on the land and developed ground (design/gdd/travel-map.md rules 8, 31-34, Formulas B, J and M), read by MapWorks. works: Formula J's table (layer 2 has no max and names its pricing track, user decision 2026-11-24; track_surcharge: the price factor per level above the track's free level) (layer 2 shared, layer 1 home; permanent or upkept): gain per level as stat (density, share points to a chosen element, or production), max level, cost_lt x cost_growth^(L-1), materials per level (rarity at least rarity_min, of the chosen element for a share work), seasons per level (permanent; upkept take 1), upkeep per level per season, fade_seasons (unpaid seasons per lost level). Tụ Linh Trận stays in crafting_formations.json on density_bonus until Formations #17 moves it to layer 1 (counted once either way). caps: Formula B's per-layer caps (all removed for layers 2 and 1 on 2026-11-24, user decision; what is left is historical; share caps 30 on layers 2 and 1; match gain caps m2 0.15, m1 0.15). prebuilt_density: the layer-2 upkept works settlements and sect seats start with (Formula M), kept up by their holders. settled_density_cap: a home in a settlement of settled_cap_kinds stays below it; sect grounds have no settled cap (user decision 2026-11-24). Residences (rule 34, Formula M): grades 1-5, max_grade by place kind, rent_frac and buy_seasons, furnish_per_grade (layer 1), grade_realm_min (the least realm index for grades 4 and 5). abode_cost_frac: opening a cave abode on a wilderness tile costs round(linh_thach_max[realm] x abode_cost_frac) and one season (rule 8). All values but the GDD's are guesses.

sects._doc: Sects develop their land (SectWorks; Travel & Map rules 31-33, Sects F2 work_max = ceil(Holdings / 2)): the works a sect builds on its sites and at its seat, paid from the Holdings track's investment. density_value_per_member: a seat density work's season value per member per density point, to rank it against production works (guess). builds_per_season: most levels a sect builds a season. save_seasons_max: a sect saves its works budget toward the best work when that work costs up to this many seasons of budget, and save_payback_max: only if the work pays back its cost within this many seasons (cost / value; guesses, 2026-11-24).
